sentence: This project builds a safety filter that corrects unsafe robot actions using expert demonstrations of safe behavior.
This project uses mathematical models and genetic data to find the rules of pathogen evolution.
This project builds security monitoring software and tools for a smart environment that tracks activities and energy usage.
This project studies enzymes in bacteria that change natural products and the proteins that help them work.
This project studies how sulfur-containing groups can be used to make and tune the properties of polymers.
This project studies the mucus of land snails to find out how it shapes the way species live together.
This project builds a model for data shaped like graphs, such as molecules and proteins, that also uses text and images.
This project builds an open medical knowledge base of diseases, with symptoms, causes, and treatments, and tests it on predicting health risks.
This project builds mirror coatings for gravitational wave detectors that have very low optical absorption and low mechanical loss.
This project measures the entropy and charge flow of fractional quantum Hall states in graphene devices.
This project studies optimization problems whose solutions stay robust against changes in the environment, and applies them to robots that detect threats.
This project tests embedded-memory devices at cryogenic temperatures to see whether they save energy and improve performance for data-intensive workloads.
This project uses artificial intelligence to design hydrogel scaffolds that mimic the kidney and studies how they affect stem cells becoming renal tissue.
This project builds methods that let teams of autonomous surface vehicles choose where to sample water and coordinate with limited communication.
This project compares invasive and native hemlock woolly adelgid populations to see how their genetic variation and cold tolerance differ.
This project builds a database linking the biogeochemical properties of Antarctic photoautotrophs to spectroscopic properties that drones, aircraft, and satellites can detect.
